amount.description: Amount of top-level categories to show, with a link to the category page for the rest. Will show all if not set

order_by.description: How to order the categories. For example 'name' to order by name, and 'length' to order by number of posts. Orders by name if not set

order.description: 1 for ascending order, or -1 for descending order. Ascending if not set

depth.description: Levels of categories to show, for example 1 for the top-level categories only. Shows all levels if not set or 0

show_current.description: Whether to highlight the categories of the current post

show_count.description: Whether to show the number of posts of each category
